This section collects Jupyter notebooks with Python implementations of the adversarial attacks and defenses covered in the lectures. The notebooks accompany the lecture slides and serve as starting points for the homework assignments and the course project. Students are encouraged to use the GPUs provided by Google Colab for running the notebooks.

Each notebook can be viewed on this website, opened directly in Google Colab, or downloaded from the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/avakanski/Spring-2026-Adversarial-Machine-Learning/tree/main/Codes).
